about: One loop per stage type: which phases a stage has and what each phase must produce. Every loop starts with the same mandatory phase, clarify: Claude must ask itself whether it has enough context to complete the stage on its own, and fill the gap with the user when it has not. It never says HOW a phase is done (tools, sessions, plugins): that is decided outside Blueprint when the stage opens. Read by the create-plan skill, the stage-opening step and the plan-guard hook. Claude never edits this file.

phases.produces: the context check for this topic: Claude asks itself whether it has enough context to take it on its own; if not, a short discussion with the user (or the user saying the context was misunderstood) fills the gap
a divergent proposal: many possible options first, then Claude's recommendation and why it wins
a choice; the user makes the hard-to-change ones
the decision written down (blueprint/decisions/ or the context card)

discussion.done_when: every topic has a written decision or is postponed with a reason

implementation.purpose: Build and verify one or more parts.

phases.produces: the context check: Claude asks itself whether it has enough context to carry out the stage on its own (decisions written, state of the code); if not, a short discussion with the user fills the gap

phases.when: the work must be merged into a main line

implementation.done_when: green tests, review passed, work merged if planned

delivery.purpose: Make something to show, quickly and at low risk: a mockup, a small demo on code or infrastructure that already exists, a presentation, a video, a document. Not new production features: those are implementation.

phases.produces: the context check: Claude asks itself whether it has enough context to make it on its own (who it is for, format, message, limits); if not, a short discussion with the user fills the gap
the thing to show, consistent with the written decisions

phases.when: it is shown live to someone other than the user (a demo, a presentation)
phases.produces: a full run-through done; a plan B if needed
shown to the user, or handed to whom it is for
the feedback recorded as notes or as proposed plan changes

quick_task.purpose: A short, low-risk job: a mockup, find out an unknown (cost, feasibility, access), check something that already exists (load, security), a small fix.

phases.produces: the context check: Claude asks itself whether it has enough context to do the job on its own (how the user wants it, parameters someone gave, limits); if not, a short (not hurried) discussion with the user fills the gap
the result in a few lines; if something changes, a proposed plan change
